_note: WO-672 Slice D + WO-892 - structure damage-state thresholds for StructureDamageVisuals. HP-fraction thresholds: <= smolder = thin smoke wisp (Damage_Smolder); <= fire = flame + smoke volume (Damage_Fire); <= criticalBeacon = an ADDITIONAL fast-strobing alarm loop plus a '!' glyph (Damage_CriticalBeacon) meaning 'repair me NOW before it is destroyed'; broken (hp==0) = one-shot Damage_BreakBurst at the break transition + a persistent Damage_Ruin column, and the beacon STOPS (a destroyed structure cannot be saved - WO-753: destroyed is gone, it returns only via a full-cost rebuild). WO-892 moved these off Ember_Burn/Raid_Explosion: Ember_Burn pointed at a Hovl path that does not exist so it never reached the catalog and never rendered, and Raid_Explosion pointed into the gitignored Hovl pack. The four states read in GREYSCALE by smoke density, flame presence, pulse rhythm and layer count - never by tint (the owner is red/green colourblind). maxBurnLoops and maxCriticalBeacons are SEPARATE worst-first caps on top of VFXManager's global 20-loop cap; a structure holds at most one burn/ruin loop AND at most one beacon, so the worst case this system can hold is maxBurnLoops + maxCriticalBeacons. perType keys are lowercase structure kinds; optOut skips the shared tells for types with bespoke damage presentation (gate force-field collapse, heart crystal states). Dual-copy rule: keep Assets/StreamingAssets/Data/Canonical/damage-states.json byte-identical.
